objective: Keep the competition single-worker exact-hash Agent1 runtime, but make the configured eight-item batch size a capacity ceiling instead of the UI running-state claim unit. Claim only the first immediately executable Provider char-budget batch so remaining Agent1-ready items stay pending until their actual turn.
acceptanceCriteria: If fewer than eight Agent1 items are ready, all currently ready items may run immediately without waiting for capacity to fill.
If the candidate window exceeds the Agent1 batch char budget, only the first char-budget prefix is claimed as agent1_running.
Items outside the current Provider subbatch remain agent1_pending and are not displayed as already running.
The existing V22.5.7 Agent1 stage owner and V22.5.9 exact hash token runtime remain unchanged.
The existing single station worker remains the only worker and no ThreadPool or asyncio fan-out is introduced.
Each completed Provider subbatch returns to the worker loop before the next Agent1 prefix is selected, allowing progressive frontend runtime-state refresh.
Input preparation failures in the selected prefix remain owned by the existing hard runtime and cannot be starved in pending state.
